Why 10, −15 and 6
  • with a straight start and end, \(d(t) = d_1\, q(t/T)\)
  • Path Generation's \(q(u)\) = \(10u^{3} - 15u^{4} + 6u^{5}\)
  • each coefficient of \(q\), times \(d_{1}\), over \(T^{3}\), \(T^{4}\) or \(T^{5}\) (the readout above)
